lines.greeting: Oh, this floor is a mess! Could you clean every stain in 30 seconds? I'll give you 100 coins.
lines.rewarded: How spotless! Here are your 100 coins, dear.
lines.failed: Oh, you ran out of time. Shall we try again?
lines.alreadyDone: You've done enough for today, dear. Come back tomorrow!
lines.unavailable: Oh dear, something went wrong. Please try again.

lines.greeting: Fancy a game of memory? Find all 8 pairs in 20 moves at most, and I'll give you 150 coins.
lines.rewarded: Well, I never! You beat me. Here are your 150 coins.
lines.failed: Ha! Out of moves, my memory is still the best. Another game?
lines.alreadyDone: One defeat a day is enough for me. Come back tomorrow!
lines.unavailable: Hm, I've mislaid my cards. Please try again.

lines.greeting: Hey! Can you catch me a Magikarp from the lake? Please! I'll give you 50 coins, and something even better if it's a golden one!
lines.rewarded: Wow, a Magikarp! It's so cool! Thanks a lot, here are your 50 coins!
lines.rewardedShiny: NO WAY!!! A GOLDEN MAGIKARP!!! THIS IS THE BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!!! Here, take this booster from the very latest set!!!
lines.failed: Oh no, you stopped already? Come on, one more try!
lines.alreadyDone: I've got my fish for today! Come back tomorrow!
lines.unavailable: Oh, my line is all tangled up. Try again!
